Create a clean 4K 16:9 character-design proportion lineup, restrained 2D hand-drawn animation, seven ordinary ancient Chinese people and their matching head studies. No text, symbols, labels, scale ticks or height lines.
The top 75 percent of the canvas is a FULL BODY LINEUP on a SINGLE shared foot baseline. All seven figures stand flat, upright, at exactly the same camera distance. Do not use perspective depth to vary height. Heads and feet fully inside frame. Keep clear space between bodies. Seven small matching portraits in the SAME order form one lower row.
The first TWO figures are the main proportion anchor: a broad-faced adult father and his slender preteen daughter, about ten years old, not a toddler. The girl's total standing height must be THREE QUARTERS of the father's total standing height. If his head top is at y=200 and his soles at y=1500, her head top is at y=525 and her soles at y=1500. Those are layout instructions only, never print them. Her crown is at his upper chest, close under the armpit level, well above his waist and elbow. Her HEAD is approximately the same anatomical size as his head; her torso and legs are shorter. Do not shrink an entire adult or draw an oversized baby head. She wears TWO small hair buns and muted light-brown cross-collar cloth clothes. The father wears muted gray-green cross-collar cloth clothes. Both have empty hands, relaxed beside their bodies. They stand immediately adjacent, without overlap.
To their right, figures THREE and FOUR are a gray-purple-clothed mother and her short-haired, rice-gray-clothed boy. He is younger and visibly shorter than the first girl. Both empty-handed, no infant in arms.
Figure FIVE is a thick-shouldered square-faced adult man in earth-brown cloth, holding ONE gray hemp rice sack in his arms. Figure SIX is a DIFFERENT slim-built long-faced adult man in dark gray short cloth, BOTH hands clearly empty and separated from his body. No pole, stick, weapon, tool or other item beside this sixth man.
Figure SEVEN is a solitary woman in rice-gray blouse and plain black skirt. Her RIGHT HAND holds exactly ONE small blank ticket. Her LEFT HAND is empty. Exactly one ticket in the entire image, one sack in the entire image. The first pair remain at the far left, mother and son next, then the two distinct men and ticket woman. No eighth person, no cut-off limb, no merged bodies.
Pale warm gray background, soft upper-left daylight, calm thin contours, natural human proportions, low-saturation cloth colors and only two-level cel shadows. Simple ancient cloth crossing collars and fabric ties. No modern buttoned collars, zippers, frog fasteners, uniforms, decorative embroidery, photo skin, paper grain or gritty texture. This is an identity sheet, not a scene of distributing rice.
